body:
Fresh start — version reset to 1.0.0, everything since v2.3.4 folded in.

- Stealth only says Connected after the tunnel really carries traffic. Dead servers get skipped and marked dead, proven ones rank first with a working ✓ badge.
- Every connect tries your picked DNS first.
- AdShield on? If its DNS breaks the connect, the app retries once with AdShield off for that session and tells you.
- No more stuck "Connecting..." after the log already said Connected.
- Settings → Check for update: the app checks GitHub for new releases, downloads the APK and opens the installer.
- Server lists refreshed (3 new Stealth feeds, WARP 7th endpoint) and auto-refresh whenever the app opens.

Old releases are gone — v1.0.0 is the only one now. If you have any 2.x build installed, uninstall it first, then install this one (fresh version number, same signing key).
name: IPChakra v1.0.0 — Fresh start
